request.style: English, male baritone solo with soft female choir, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, timpani, reverent and hopeful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Consume them in wrath
Till they are no more
Then they will know
God rules over Jacob
To the ends of the earth

[Verse]
They return at evening
Snarling like dogs
Prowling around the city
Roaming for food
If not filled they howl
Through the dark night

[Chorus]
But I will sing of your strength
In the morning I will sing aloud
Of your mercy
For you have been my fortress
My refuge in my distress

[Verse]
O my Strength
To you I sing praise
For God is my fortress
My God of mercy

[Chorus]
But I will sing of your strength
In the morning I will sing aloud
Of your mercy
For you have been my fortress
My refuge in my distress

[Bridge]
In the day of my distress
You are my fortress
My God of mercy

[Chorus]
But I will sing of your strength
In the morning I will sing aloud
Of your mercy
For you have been my fortress
My refuge in my distress

[Outro]
O my Strength
To you I sing praise
